habitat: Open woodland, forest edge, scrub, cultivated areas, gardens and orchards; canopy bird, avoids deep forest; 0–1600 m
description: Small yellow-and-black (breeding male) / olive-green (female) canopy bird with two white wing bars; forages for insects and spiders among leaves high in trees, often in pairs; open woodland, scrub, gardens and orchards of the Jammu lowlands; famous whistled "wheee-tee" song and mimicry.
